scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @rekt-ink/api & npm run dev -w @rekt-ink/web
scripts.build:terminal: npm run build -w @rekt-ink/episodes && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/learning && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/api && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/web
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @rekt-ink/episodes && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/learning && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/api && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/web && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-api && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-verifier
scripts.build:inkubator:services: npm run build -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-api && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-verifier
scripts.build:inkubator:render: npm run build -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-api && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-lab -- --outDir dist
scripts.build:inkubator:product: npm run build:inkubator:services && npm run build:inkubator && npm run build:devkit
scripts.build:canonical: npm run build:core && npm run build:inkubator && npm run build:devkit
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rekt-ink/episodes && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/learning && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/episodes && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/learning && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/api && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/web && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-api && npm run typecheck -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-verifier
scripts.verify:episodes: node scripts/verify-episodes.mjs && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/episodes && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/sim
scripts.test: npm run verify:core && npm run verify:source && npm run verify:pwa && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/episodes && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/sim && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/career && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/learning && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/api && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/web && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-api && npm run test:career-tuning && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/inkubator-verifier
scripts.verify: npm run verify:core && npm run verify:source && npm run verify:product-boundaries && npm run verify:inkubator-foundation && npm run verify:inkubator-api-client && npm run verify:inkubator-signal-system && npm run verify:pwa && npm run verify:episodes && npm run verify:learning && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:devkit: npm run build -w @rekt-ink/sdk && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/cli && npm run build -w @rekt-ink/mcp
scripts.test:devkit: npm run test -w @rekt-ink/protocol && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/sdk && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/cli && npm run test -w @rekt-ink/mcp
scripts.verify:devkit: npm run build:devkit && npm run test:devkit
